requiredCriteria.observation: learner asks what the staff recommend
learner chooses consistently with the recommendation given
learner orders a slice of cake or a truthful alternative

optionalCriteria.observation: learner uses a level of politeness and address that fits the relationship

objectives.sourceGoalText: your order came out wrong - politely ask them to fix it

title.es: Tu pedido ha salido mal: pedir con educación que lo arreglen
title.en: Your order came out wrong — politely ask them to fix it
title.it: L'ordine è arrivato sbagliato: chiedere con garbo di sistemarlo
title.tr: Siparişin yanlış geldi: kibarca düzeltmelerini istemek
title.ar: طلبك جاء خطأ: اطلب بلباقة تصحيحه
title.uk: Твоє замовлення принесли не те — ввічливо попросити виправити

requiredCriteria.observation: learner explains what is wrong with the order
learner asks for the order to be corrected or an equivalent remedy
learner keeps the complaint polite

optionalCriteria.observation: learner confirms or checks the agreed detail before the exchange ends
